meta.dataset: Simple offline irrigation planner reference map
meta.notes: Maps farmer-friendly crop growth stages to configured reference stages. Missing crop-stage values remain unavailable. Measured mode uses field readings. Estimated mode uses daily weather from a confirmed starting condition. Flooded rice uses a separate pond balance. Published efficiency ranges produce a gross-application range, not a point value.

meta.formula: ETc = ET0 × Kc; TAW = 1000 × (θFC − θWP) × root depth; Dr = 1000 × (θFC − θcurrent) × root depth; RAW = adjusted p × TAW; net refill is shown when Dr ≥ RAW; volume (litres) = depth (mm) × field area (m²); gross range divides by the published method efficiency bounds.
limitations: Historical district ETo climate normals are not today's weather or field rainfall observations.
Only manual or weather-station rainfall dated after the matching soil-moisture reading can be credited. Forecast/model rainfall and climate normals are never deducted.
Effective rainfall requires measured runoff/non-infiltration loss and measured root-zone storage; rain already reflected in the soil-moisture reading is excluded.
Flooded rice uses a separate one-day balance for standing water, bund overflow, seepage and percolation.
Measured upland calculations require field inputs. Estimated calculations can use published texture midpoints and established-root depth references.
FAO-56 p adjustment assumes tabulated values near ETc 5 mm/day and is only a planning reference.
